extraction: Agent Eval Harness (linny006): Live, open-source benchmark for comparing AI coding agents on real GitHub issues. Lists related projects: Giskard (5801 stars, open-source evaluation/testing for LLM agents), TruLens (3533 stars, evaluation/tracking for LLM experiments and AI agents), SilentTrustBench (benchmark: do LLMs silently trust plausible-but-wrong tool data?), gauntlet-evals (pip install gauntlet-evals), fieldtest (LLM evaluation framework - define correct/well-formed/safe before measuring). Active ecosystem with multiple evaluation frameworks.
